title: Monitor not showing
summary: One monitor is missing from Power Display, but the current report still does not separate unsupported topology/connection from hidden-monitor filtering or monitor discovery failure.
next_action: Request the topology and Power Display-specific diagnostics that distinguish why the LG monitor is absent.

confidence.rationale: The VCP dump proves some monitor communication exists, but the report still does not identify whether Power Display discovered and hid the monitor, or failed to enumerate it at all.

judgment.rationale: The report is missing the specific monitor topology and Power Display diagnostics needed to tell whether this is a connection/DDC limitation, a hidden-monitor preference, or an enumeration bug.
evidence: The reporter attached a screenshot and later pasted a VCP capabilities dump for the LG monitor.
The issue does not explain the physical connection path, whether DDC/CI is enabled, or whether the monitor ever appeared in Power Display.
Power Display filters hidden monitors out of the visible list in src/modules/powerdisplay/PowerDisplay/ViewModels/MainViewModel.Monitors.cs.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for monitor-topology details, a screenshot of the current Power Display surface, and a fresh bug report after opening the module.

fix_assessment.rationale: A repo-side fix is not scoped until the team can distinguish a monitor-discovery bug from configuration or hardware visibility constraints.

issue_context.summary: Power Display does not show one LG external monitor, even though the reporter can provide a VCP capabilities listing from that display.
known_information: The report is against PowerToys 0.101.2362.0 on Windows 11.
The missing display appears to be an external LG HDR 4K monitor.
The discussion includes a VCP capabilities dump showing brightness, contrast, input source, power mode, and several manufacturer-specific VCP codes.
No bug report ZIP is attached.
inferences: Some DDC/CI communication appears to exist, so the problem may be in discovery/filtering rather than absolute lack of monitor control support.
Without the physical connection chain and Power Display surface state, it is still possible the monitor is filtered out by settings or by an unsupported topology path.
issue_context.analysis: The report already contains useful monitor-specific data. The missing discriminator is whether Power Display discovered the monitor and hid it, or failed earlier during discovery.
initial_investigation: Power Display builds the visible monitor list from DiscoverMonitorsAsync() and then filters out persisted hidden monitor IDs in MainViewModel.UpdateMonitorList().
Current repo history shows recent monitor-detection work, but no directly linked fix for this exact LG-monitor symptom was found in the issue thread.
There is no assignee or linked PR on this issue yet.

information_gaps.information: The exact monitor topology and connection path for the missing LG display, including HDMI/DisplayPort/USB-C, dock/KVM use, and whether DDC/CI is enabled in the monitor OSD.
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes a Power Display discovery/filtering bug from a connection path that prevents Windows/DDC enumeration.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please list how each monitor is connected and whether DDC/CI is enabled on the affected LG display.

information_gaps.information: A screenshot of the current Power Display window showing every monitor card that does appear.
information_gaps.why_needed: It shows whether the monitor is absent entirely or present under an unexpected identity/state.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Open Power Display, capture the full window, and upload the screenshot through the GitHub issue web UI.

information_gaps.information: A fresh PowerToys diagnostic ZIP captured immediately after opening Power Display with the monitor missing.
information_gaps.why_needed: The PowerToys logs are needed to see what the module discovered and whether the monitor was filtered or rejected.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please open Power Display, reproduce the missing-monitor state, and then add a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately afterward.

actions.label: Provide monitor topology and Power Display diagnostics

comment.body:
Thanks for sharing the VCP capabilities dump — that is already useful because it shows the LG display can answer at least some monitor-control queries.

**Needed**
1. Please describe the exact monitor topology for the missing LG display: connection type (HDMI / DisplayPort / USB-C), any dock or KVM in the path, and whether **DDC/CI** is enabled in the monitor’s on-screen menu.
2. Please upload a screenshot of the full **Power Display** window showing the monitors that do appear.
3. Please open Power Display in the failing state and then add a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately afterward.

This will distinguish a Power Display discovery/filtering bug from a connection or monitor-capability limitation.
